The subagent found 16 `http.matchers.*` modules in non-test files. Its summary said 15 at first, then listed 16. I'm reporting the 16 it listed. The `ID:` field lines are in each file's `CaddyModule()` method, with line numbers from its grep. It didn't open each one to confirm, though the matching `RegisterModule` calls make it very likely.

All paths are under `modules/caddyhttp/`.

| Module ID | File |
|---|---|
| `http.matchers.file` | `fileserver/matcher.go` |
| `http.matchers.vars` | `vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.vars_regexp` | `vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.expression` | `celmatcher.go` |
| `http.matchers.remote_ip` | `ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.client_ip` | `ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.host` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path_regexp` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.method` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.query` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.header` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.header_regexp` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.protocol` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.tls` | `matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.not` | `matchers.go` |

The subagent left out two places that build the ID at runtime with `"http.matchers." + matcherName`, in `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/httptype.go` and `matchers.go`. Those look modules up rather than define them. The TLS matchers in `caddytls/matchers.go` register under the TLS namespace, so they don't count.
